news.title: Anup Bagchi Takes Charge As HDFC Bank CEO: Top Challenges As Stock Nears Fresh 52-Week Low
news.summary: On October 1, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approved Bagchi's appointment as MD and CEO of HDFC Bank for a three-year term beginning October 27. An ICICI Bank veteran, Bagchi was previously the MD and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance.
